es: Resolver una llegada a una ciudad: plantear un problema de alojamiento, pedir aclaración ante jerga, confirmar lo acordado y resumir la semana con bloques naturales.

teaching.en: The heating has not worked since Monday, so please send someone to fix it by Friday at the latest.
teaching.es: La calefacción no funciona desde el lunes, así que por favor envíe a alguien a arreglarla como muy tarde el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Plantea el dato concreto y fija un plazo con by… at the latest.

teaching.en: When the landlord called the wiring dodgy, I asked, what do you mean by dodgy? Nodding politely would have solved nothing.
teaching.es: Cuando el casero dijo que el cableado era «dodgy», pregunté qué quería decir con «dodgy». Asentir con educación no habría resuelto nada.
teaching.explanationEs: Ante jerga, repite la palabra y pregunta qué significa en vez de asentir sin entender.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase plantea el problema con datos, cortesía y plazo?

choices.text: You have never fixed anything here, so I expect you to repair the heating immediately.
Hello, there might be some problem with the heating, perhaps, in some way, if that is possible.
Hello, the heating has not worked since Monday and my room is freezing; could you fix it by Friday at the latest?

feedback.es: El mensaje cortés da el dato, la consecuencia y una petición con plazo; el que acusa ofende y el que duda tanto no pide nada.

hint.es: Busca el mensaje con un dato concreto y una petición educada con fecha.

prompt.es: Completa: «Yo tenía la impresión de que la agencia ya te había hablado de la gotera.»

feedback.es: Under the impression that señala que esperabas algo distinto de lo que ocurrió.

origin.text: I was under the ___ that the agency had already told you about the leak in my ceiling.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Ten paciencia mientras busco la dirección.»

answer.text: Bear with me while I find the address

feedback.es: Bear with me pide unos segundos de paciencia mientras haces algo.

hint.es: Empieza con la fórmula que pide paciencia.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debe hacer Sara el viernes.

choices.text: Be at home before ten and leave the bathroom open.
Be at home all day and leave the bathroom door unlocked.
Be home before ten and call the agency to confirm the plumber.

feedback.es: Debe estar en casa antes de las diez y dejar abierta la puerta del baño, de donde parece venir la gotera.

origin.audio: Hi Sara, it's the agency. The plumber can't come today, but he will fix the heating on Friday morning. Basically, you just need to be home before ten, and please make sure the bathroom door is unlocked, because the leak seems to come from there.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta pide aclaración ante una palabra que no conoces?

choices.text: Yes, yes, of course; dodgy is fine.
Sorry, what do you mean by dodgy? Is it safe?
Sorry, I think dodgy means good, so no problem.

feedback.es: Repetir la palabra y preguntar qué significa evita asentir sin entender, sobre todo si hay riesgo.

origin.text: The landlord says: «Don't worry, the wiring is a bit dodgy, but it's fine.» You do not know the word dodgy, and the wiring could be dangerous.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con su función en la conversación.

pairs: I was under the impression that…

feedback.es: Cada fórmula cumple una función distinta: pedir paciencia, aclarar, señalar una expectativa y fijar un plazo.

pairs: I was under the impression that…

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué sugiere el casero sobre el edificio.

choices.text: That the agency will not help with any repair before next week.
That the plumber has misjudged how much the heating repair will cost.
That the building has bigger problems than this one repair.

feedback.es: Dice que el plomero solo arregla la calefacción, que es el tercer problema del mes y que el plomero es lo de menos: sugiere problemas más amplios; la agencia sí paga la calefacción.

origin.audio: Sara, it's Carlos. The plumber says the heating is dodgy, so he will change a part on Friday. No worries about the cost: the agency will pay for everything. Mind you, he also said that the leak in your ceiling is not his department, so I will have to call somebody else, and I cannot promise anything before next week. To be honest, this is the third problem this month, and I am beginning to think that the plumber is the least of it. Anyway, bear with me: I will get to the bottom of it and call you on Monday at the latest.

prompt.es: ¿Por qué escribe la remitente este correo?

choices.text: To confirm what was agreed and let the agency correct it.
To complain that the agency has already broken a promise.
To warn the agency that she will stop paying rent until the heating works.

feedback.es: Resume lo acordado para comprobar que lo entendió y pide que la corrijan antes del jueves: busca confirmar, no quejarse.

origin.text: Dear Ms Hughes, thank you for your quick reply. I am writing to make sure I understand: you will send a plumber on Friday, the agency will pay for the parts, and my security deposit will not be touched. Bear with me if I am being too careful: in my last flat, nobody kept their word. If any of this is wrong, please tell me by Thursday at the latest.

prompt.es: Completa: «El casero dice que la fianza se devolverá en un mes.»

feedback.es: Security deposit es la fianza que se deja como garantía al alquilar.

origin.text: The landlord says that the ___ deposit will be returned within a month, once the flat has been checked and the keys are back.

prompt.es: Escribe al casero: problema, petición con plazo, aclaración, confirmación y resumen.

answer.text: Hello Carlos, it's Sara from room four. The thing is, the heating has not worked since Monday, and my room is freezing. There is also a leak above the bed, and I was under the impression that the agency already knew about it. Could you send someone to fix both problems by Friday at the latest? You also said that the wiring is a bit dodgy. Sorry, what do you mean by dodgy? Is it safe? Bear with me, because I want to make sure I understand: you will send a plumber on Friday morning, and the agency will pay for the parts, is that right? To be honest, it has been a long first week, but I managed to sort out my phone contract, and I am pretty much settled in. Mind you, I am still a little tired, and I would like to sleep in a warm room soon. Anyway, thank you very much for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Dear Carlos, I am writing about room four. First, the heating is not working, and it has been freezing since Monday. Second, there is a leak in the ceiling, and I thought the agency had told you. Could you please arrange a repair by Thursday at the latest? In your message you described the wiring as dodgy, and I am afraid I do not know that word. What does dodgy mean, exactly? To make sure I understand, a plumber will come on Friday and the agency will pay for the parts, right? The thing is, it has been a tiring first week, but I managed to buy a bus pass and to find a supermarket, so I am settling in. Anyway, thank you in advance for your reply, and I hope we can get to the bottom of this problem together.

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje plantea el problema, pide con un plazo, aclara la jerga, confirma lo acordado y resume la semana con un bloque natural.

origin.text: Acabas de llegar a una ciudad. La calefacción de tu habitación no funciona y el casero dijo que «is a bit dodgy», pero no lo entendiste. Escribe un mensaje (al menos 135 palabras; ideal, 220): plantea el problema, pide que lo arreglen con un plazo, pregunta qué significa «dodgy», confirma lo que has entendido y resume tu primera semana con un bloque (to be honest, the thing is…) y un verbo con to o -ing (manage to…).

prompt.es: ¿Qué deduce Sara de las respuestas del casero?

choices.text: That he is busy but will send the plumber within days.
That he is avoiding a firm commitment.
That he doubts the plumber is really needed.

feedback.es: Responde «pronto» y «ya veré», y cambia de tema a la fianza: elude comprometerse, y por eso Sara lo anota.

origin.text: Sara asked the landlord when the plumber would come. «Soon,» he said. She asked again, and he said that these things take a while, and that he would see what he could do. Then he asked whether she had paid the deposit. Sara wrote the whole conversation down in her phone, word for word, before going to bed.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por favor, arregle la gotera como muy tarde el viernes.»

answer.text: Please fix the leak by Friday at the latest

feedback.es: El plazo se fija con by + día + at the latest, al final de la petición.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ha sido una semana difícil, pero logré arreglar la calefacción yo mismo.»

feedback.es: Manage + to + verbo expresa que conseguiste algo con esfuerzo.

origin.text: It has been a difficult week. I did not think I could, but I ___ to fix the heating myself, and the room is finally warm again.
